# Pull Request

## Description
Explain the change and which file(s) it affects.

## Type of change
- [ ] New guide
- [ ] Update existing guide
- [ ] Add rates/data
- [ ] Add calculator/script
- [ ] Fix typo/format

## Checklist
- [ ] I have cited sources for data added
- [ ] I added examples for calculators (if any)
- [ ] I updated README if needed

## Additional notes
Add any special instructions or testing steps for reviewers.
